title: Fixed point theorem for cluster modular groups
summary: We prove that any finite subgroup $G \subset Γ_{\boldsymbol{s}}$ of the cluster modular group has fixed points in the cluster manifolds $\mathcal{A}_{\boldsymbol{s}}(\mathbb{R}_{>0})$ and $\mathcal{X}_{\boldsymbol{s}}(\mathbb{R}_{>0})$ under a certain condition. This generalizes Kerckhoff's Nielsen realization theorem [Ker83] for the mapping class group action on the Teichmüller space. The condition holds whenever $Γ_{\boldsymbol{s}}$ admits a cluster DT transformation, and it can be also verified for all finite mutation types except for $X_7$.
